meta.source: wowforevertalents.com/racials — WoW Forever client build 1.60.1.70862 (+ hotfixes 2026-11-07)
meta.note: Some guides still list 'Mace Specialization' as a Dwarf racial; the client data lists Artisan's Precision instead. Gun Specialization and Frost Resistance were removed.

racials.name: Stoneform
racials.text: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.
racials.classicText: While active, grants immunity to Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects. In addition, Armor increased by 10%. Lasts 8 sec.
racials.notes: Self-cleanse + tank mitigation. Bind it in the same 'defensive' cluster for all specs.

racials.name: Find Treasure
racials.text: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap and sometimes increase treasure found. Lasts until cancelled.
racials.notes: Tracking toggle; doesn't need a prime key (minimap menu or a far keyboard key).

racials.name: Artisan's Precision
racials.text: Increases your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%.

racials.name: Big Game Hunter
racials.text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
